name: c-skeleton-1
title: Skeleton loader for avatars and user info.
label: Avatar Info
description: Skeleton loader for avatars and user info.

guidance.bestFor: A 48px avatar circle beside 2 fixed width text bars, the second shorter, with no card around them

whenNotToUse.when: A titled list of avatar rows, each ending in its own action button

name: c-skeleton-2
title: Skeleton loader for a card component.
label: Card
description: Skeleton loader for a card component.

guidance.bestFor: A card that opens with 2 title bars of falling width above a 16:9 media block, with no footer

whenNotToUse.when: A card that leads with its image and ends in a row of buttons

name: c-skeleton-3
title: Skeleton loader for text and paragraphs.
label: Text Paragraphs
description: Skeleton loader for text and paragraphs.

guidance.bestFor: Body copy in 2 paragraphs of full width lines, each closing on a shorter line, with no heading or image

whenNotToUse.when: Copy set inside a card under an image, with buttons below it
Text arriving as bubbles from 2 sides of a conversation

guidance.bestFor: A stack of 2 label bars over full width input bars, closed by one shorter button bar

whenNotToUse.when: A conversation view whose only field is the reply box under the bubbles

name: c-skeleton-5
title: Skeleton loader for a data table.
label: Data Table
description: Skeleton loader for a data table.

guidance.bestFor: A 3 column header row with a bottom border over 4 body rows, laid out with flex divs, not table markup
agentNotes: Placeholder rows come from `Array.from` with a `length` of 4; match it to your page size so the loaded rows do not shift the layout

whenNotToUse.when: Placeholder rows inside a sortable, paged records table with known columns

name: c-skeleton-6
title: Skeleton loader for a dashboard stats row
label: Stats Row
description: Skeleton loader for a dashboard stats row

guidance.bestFor: A row of 3 metric cards, each a small label bar over a tall value bar and a caption line
agentNotes: `grid-cols-3` has no breakpoint, so the 3 cards stay in one row on a phone, where their `w-24` value bars can overflow and clip

name: c-skeleton-7
title: Skeleton loader for a list with actions
label: List With Actions
description: Skeleton loader for a list with actions

guidance.bestFor: A titled list with a header button bar over 3 divided rows of avatar, 2 text lines and a trailing action bar

whenNotToUse.when: One avatar with its name lines and no list header or row button

name: c-skeleton-8
title: Skeleton loader for a card grid
label: Card Grid
description: Skeleton loader for a card grid

guidance.bestFor: A card led by a 16:9 media block, then a heading bar and 2 copy lines over a footer with a wide and a square button bar
agentNotes: Only one `Card` renders despite the card grid title; repeat it inside your own grid wrapper for as many cards as a page holds

whenNotToUse.when: A card whose title bars sit above the image, with no footer

name: c-skeleton-9
title: Skeleton loader for a full profile page
label: Profile Page
description: Skeleton loader for a full profile page

guidance.bestFor: A profile card with an 80px avatar, name lines and 3 stat pairs, above a details card of 4 label and value rows
agentNotes: `CardHeader` is a grid, so its `items-center` leaves the avatar and name bars at the left edge; add justify-items-center to center them

guidance.bestFor: Incoming bubbles with an avatar and sender bar, one outgoing bubble on the right and a reply field with a square button bar

whenNotToUse.when: One reply that waits and then streams in under turns already on screen
A form of labeled fields above a single button
